description: React component for displaying detailed information about a selected role node in the ExploreMindmap. Includes logic for fetching additional role details from an API, displays role attributes, skills, tags, and handles loading/error states.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to string, trims whitespace, and handles null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array of strings, sanitizing each element.

methods.name: looksLikeUuid
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the UUID format.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role ID from a role object, considering multiple possible property names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role title from a role object, considering multiple possible property names.
